dedupe_keys.name: an open dataset of yangtze river docks based on osm and google satellite imagery 2024

description: An Open Dataset of Yangtze River Docks Based on OSM and Google Satellite Imagery (2024) is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Qi Zhou et al. As critical infrastructure at the sea-land interface, docks support regional economies and transportation networks. They include seaport docks and inland docks, the latter widely distributed along rivers, lakes, and canals. However, existing studies have mainly focused on seaport dock identification, with limited research and data products for inland docks. Coverage: not stated; published in 2026. Formats: Shapefile, Image. The data are held in Figshare and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 5565426 Bytes. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
